description: This file defines the LeaveRequestDao class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing leave request data access operations. It includes methods for saving, updating, querying, and manipulating leave requests, leaves, entitlements, and related entities, integrating transaction management and complex query logic to handle leave overlaps, status updates, and filtering based on various parameters.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing leave requests and related entities within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for CRUD operations, complex queries, and business logic enforcement concerning employee leave management.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Persists a leave request along with its associated leave entries and entitlements, handling transactional integrity.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Saves a comment on a leave request, setting its creation time if null.

methods.name: saveLeave
methods.description: Persists a leave entity to the database.

methods.name: changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a leave, optionally removing linked entitlements and updating entitlement usage accordingly, within a transaction.

methods.name: getOverlappingLeave
methods.description: Retrieves leave entries that overlap with a given date range for a specific employee, considering partial days and time periods.

methods.name: getTotalLeaveDuration
methods.description: Calculates total leave hours for an employee on a specific date, considering only non-rejected, non-cancelled, and non-holiday statuses.

methods.name: getLeaveById
methods.description: Fetches a leave entity by its ID.

methods.name: markApprovedLeaveAsTaken
methods.description: Public method to mark all approved leaves as taken if not already done.

methods.name: _markApprovedLeaveAsTaken
methods.description: Private method that updates the status of all approved leaves with dates prior to now to 'taken'.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByEmpNumberAndDateRangeQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query to retrieve leave requests for an employee within an optional date range.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByEmpNumberAndDateRange
methods.description: Retrieves leave requests for an employee within an optional date range.

methods.name: getLeavesByEmpNumberAndDates
methods.description: Fetches leave entries for an employee on specific dates.

methods.name: getLeaveRequests
methods.description: Retrieves leave requests matching specified filter parameters, with enforcement of leave status updates.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsCount
methods.description: Returns count of leave requests matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginator for leave requests query with sorting and filters.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Fetches leaves based on search filters, updating leave statuses as needed.

methods.name: getLeavesCount
methods.description: Counts leave entries based on search filters.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveRequestIds
methods.description: Returns leaves associated with given leave request IDs.

methods.name: getAllLeaveStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves all possible leave statuses.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Fetches a leave request by its ID.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Fetches leaves linked to a specific leave request.

methods.name: getLeavesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for leaves with filters and sorting.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves leaves using filter parameters, updating statuses as needed.

methods.name: getLeavesCount
methods.description: Counts leaves matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByLeaveRequestIds
methods.description: Returns leave requests given a list of IDs.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveIds
methods.description: Returns leaves based on a list of leave IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeaves
methods.description: Fetches leaves for a specific employee with filtering options.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeavesPaginator
methods.description: Builds a paginator for employee leaves with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getUsedLeaveTypeIdsByEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of leave types used by an employee within optional date range.
